children: RNS Number : 6550S  Hollywood Bowl Group plc  01 September 2026

Hollywood Bowl, the UK and Canada's largest ten-pin bowling operator, announces, pursuant to UK Listing Rule 6.4.9 R (2), that Darren Shapland, Non-Executive Chair of the Company, has been appointed as an independent Non-Executive Director and Chair of the Board of A.G. BARR p.l.c. with effect from today.
